name: YouTube
title: Clip a YouTube video and share just that part — free, no account
h1: Share part of a YouTube video
description: Make a YouTube link with a start AND an end time. Paste the video, mark the moment, share one link that plays only that part and stops when it ends. Works with Shorts. Free, no download, no account.
intro: YouTube's own timestamp link (the ?t= one) starts at the right place and then keeps going. ClippYT gives any YouTube video a link with a start and an end, at any length, and it plays through YouTube's official player so the creator keeps the view.
faq: Can I clip a YouTube Short?
Yes. Paste the Shorts link like any other; the clip page plays it in the normal player.
Does the creator still get the view?
Yes. ClippYT never copies or re-uploads video. Your link opens the original video in YouTube's embedded player, jumped to your start and stopped at your end.
